notes.buildable_only_scope: §8 可建仓票 — allocation ranks/allocates only buildable tickers; non-buildable rows (hold/observe/veto) are never allocated cash or rescued
notes.conservative_basis: occupied cash uses the most conservative valid_entry_high so allocation never under-reserves
notes.no_over_allocation: 轮到现金不够 → 降观察 — never place an order the remaining cash cannot cover
notes.fields_not_all_in_action_table: only cash_allocation_status is an action_table column; rank/required/allocated/remaining are machine-layer fields
